lines.text: مرکز تدویر سفلیین دائما تقریبا مقارن افتاب باشند بعد از انکه از اعلی تدویر دو کوکب
lines.en: The center of the epicycle of the two inferior planets is always approximately conjunct with the Sun. After the two planets from the apogee of the epicycle

lines.text: محترق کرد ند از جانب مغرب نمایان شوند پس برباط اعظم رسند و از انجا تا سافل

lines.en: of the epicycle they incline, day by day becoming closer to the Sun until in the vicinity of the western horizon under the rays

lines.text: افتاب درامده مخفی شوند بعد از ان از افتاب گذشته در جانب شرقی نمایان گردند پس برباط
lines.en: of the Sun they enter and become hidden. After that, having passed the Sun, they appear on the eastern side, then to the greatest elongation

lines.text: اعظم رسند و باز میل بافتاب کنند تا در حوالی مشرق بتحت الشعاع افتاب درامده مخفی
lines.en: they reach and again incline towards the Sun until around the east under the rays of the Sun they enter and become hidden.

lines.en: Thus from this explanation it became clear that the two inferior planets can have occultation both on the eastern side and

lines.text: هم در طرف مغرب و لهذا هرمس احکام خفای ایشانرا در هر طرف علیحده بیان نموده *
lines.en: also on the western side, and for this reason Hermes has explained the judgments of their occultation on each side separately. *

lines.en: (Judgments of the appearance of the wandering planets in the twelve signs. Judgments of the appearance of Saturn) The appearance of Saturn absolutely

lines.en: Tusi says that Saturn in this state is a dog that has fled from fear and calamity, that if anyone

lines.text: دریابد بشدت پیدا کند و او را بگزد (ظهور زحل در برج حمل) دلالت کند بر کثرت
lines.en: it finds, it will severely attack and bite him. (Appearance of Saturn in the sign of Aries) indicates the abundance of

lines.en: wars and seditions in the eastern land, and scarcity of food in the western and southern regions, and the abundance of people's greed

lines.text: بر فساد و خرابی و بسیاری تطاول دزد و حرامی و کثرت حرارت هوا و دوقت و قوت

summary.headline: Saturn’s Appearance in the Signs
summary.text: Explanation of the eastern and western occultations of the two inferior planets, attributed to Hermes, followed by judgments on Saturn’s appearance in the twelve signs. Saturn’s general appearance concerns chiefs, agriculture, slaves, elders, mountain peoples, and ancient families; in Aries and Taurus it signifies war, scarcity, corruption, storms, disease, livestock deaths, crop ruin, and flooding, with Gemini begun.
